deals.title: The biggest USP of the HSBC Premier Credit Card is not the 36% rewards on hotels or 18% on flights. It’s actually the 3% rewards (up to 6.6% Accor value) on almost everything (except fuel). 💳✨ 👉 For flights & hotels, there are other super-premium cards like HDFC Infinia and ICICI Emeralde Private Metal (EPM) that offer very similar reward rates. Plus, prices on HSBC Hopper are higher than SmartBuy, iShop, and direct booking. 👉👉In many cases, the price difference for hotels on Hopper is so high that even the 36% reward points do not make much sense . 👉 On top of that, many popular standalone hotels are not available on Hopper. 👉 Also, many Premier Card users hardly make revenue bookings—they mostly redeem reward points and airmiles for flights and hotel stays. ✈️🏨 The real strength of the Premier Card is here 👇👇👇 ✅ 3% rewards (up to 6.6% value when transferred to Accor) on spends such as: ⚡ Utilities 🏠 Rent & Real Estate Payments 🏛️ Taxes & Government Payments 🎓 Education ⚖️ Bail & Bonds 👛 Wallet Loads 🛡️ Insurance 🏦 NBFC Payments 💍 Jewellery & Gold Coins 👉 Up to ₹1 lakh monthly spend across these categories is eligible for 3% rewards. And for the rest… 💯 ✅ Unlimited 3% rewards on almost everything else, including gift cards. 🎁 ⛽ Even fuel can be covered indirectly through HP Pay Gift Cards, making the overall rewards even more attractive. 📲 Load wallets like Amazon Pay using HSBC Premier and use the balance for UPI QR code payments. Even after paying the 2.5% wallet loading fee, you still earn 3% rewards (up to 6.6% Accor value), making it a worthwhile deal for many users. ❌ Most other premium and super-premium cards have stopped giving rewards on these categories which makes HSBC Premier very useful. 🎬🍿 Buy 1 Get 1 Free movie tickets (up to ₹750 per ticket), twice every month, is another very useful benefit. All this without any renewal fee, without the pressure of achieving milestones, and without constantly worrying about MCC exclusions. 🙌 💬 If you hold the HSBC Premier Credit Card, what’s your favourite benefit? Let us know in the comments! 👇👇👇 📘 Visit SpendWisely Blog: Detailed credit card reviews & guides 👉 https://spendwisely.in Some links may be referral links in the above post.
